{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of India|Cuisine of India]] | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan cuisine]]

This is excellent with [[Cookbook:Indian Potatoes|Indian potatoes]] and [[Cookbook:Indian Rice|Indian rice]].

==Ingredients==
* 1 can [[Cookbook:Lentil|lentils]]
* 1 can [[Cookbook:Kidney Bean|kidney beans]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* ½ can [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ¼ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric]]

==Procedure==

# [[Cookbook:Chopping|Chop]] and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] the onion.
# Add the tomatoes.
# Add all the spices.
# Add the lentils and kidney beans.
# Cook everything for 20 minutes over medium heat.
